description: The opt-in Ramadan Isha rule. Ramadan 1447 runs from 2026-02-18 to 2026-03-19 in the Umm al-Qura calendar (Foundation's .islamicUmmAlQura and Java's HijrahChronology agree). The rule replaces a positive Isha interval on days that fall in Ramadan after adding the Hijri day offset, and nothing else.
